HIS 315K The United States, 1492 to 1865
Fall 2024
Required: Give Me Liberty! (Foner)
Week 1 Colonial societies. Readings: Foner ch. 1-2
Week 2 The imperial crisis: the Stamp Act and the Townshend duties. Readings: Foner ch. 4
Week 3 The French alliance and the war for independence. Readings: Foner ch. 5; Treaty of Alliance (1778)
textbooks: Give Me Liberty! An American History, Eric Foner
outcomes: Explain the causes of the American Revolution
Read a primary source in its context
